adjudication_label: batch_28:comparative mechanical performance of EHEA compositions
canonical_question: What is the specific mechanical performance profile of the AlCoCrFeNi 2.1 EHEA compared to other listed EHEAs (CoCrFeNiZr 0.5, Nb25Sc25Ti25Zr25), and what evidence supports its designation as having the most promising properties?

question_variants.question: How does the AlCoCrFeNi 2.1 EHEA compare to the other listed EHEAs (e.g., CoCrFeNiZr 0.5, Nb 25 Sc 25 Ti 25 Zr 25) regarding their specific mechanical property profiles?
question_variants.resolution_summary: The text lists AlCoCrFeNi 2.1 alongside other EHEAs (CoCrFeNiZr 0.5, Nb25Sc25Ti25Zr25) as having an 'excellent combination of strength and ductility' but does not provide specific numerical data or a direct comparative ranking of mechanical properties between AlCoCrFeNi 2.1 and the specific alloys mentioned (CoCrFeNiZr 0.5, Nb25Sc25Ti25Zr25) within the provided evidence units.

answers.answer: The provided text lists CoCrFeNiZr 0.5 and Nb25Sc25Ti25Zr25 as examples of EHEAs with an excellent combination of strength and ductility, similar to AlCoCrFeNi 2.1, but does not provide specific comparative metrics to distinguish the performance profiles of AlCoCrFeNi 2.1 against these specific alloys in a ranking or quantitative manner.
answers.measurement_outcome: listed as having excellent combination of strength and ductility
answers.mechanism: lamellar arrangement of BCC (B2) and FCC (L12) phases (for AlCoCrFeNi 2.1)
answers.boundary_limitation: No specific numerical comparison or ranking between AlCoCrFeNi 2.1 and the other listed alloys is provided in the text.
evidence_spans: AlCoCrFeNi 2.1 EHEA with lamellar arrangement of BCC (B2) and FCC (L1 2 ) solid-solution phases has shown the most promising mechanical properties [ [22] , [25] , [26] , [27] ].
AlCoCrFeNi 2.1 EHEA showed superior pitting corrosion resistance compared to 304 stainless steel in chloride solution at room temperature [ [27] ].
This EHEA exhibited an excellent combination of high yield strength (~750 MPa) and ductility (elongation ~18%) at room temperature [ [22] , [28] ].
